name: parent-group-site-template
description: A static website for a school parent group (PTA, PTO, PTC): pages, news, programs, and a merged school calendar, generated from one config file.

scripts.build:site: npm run build:config && npm run build:pages && npm run build:blog && npm run build:programs
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-pages.test.mjs && node scripts/page-data.test.mjs && node scripts/build-blog.test.mjs && node scripts/build-programs.test.mjs && node scripts/supplies-page.test.mjs && node scripts/calendar-categorize.test.mjs
